summary: John's 4th-great-grand-uncle; transported to New South Wales after the 1834 Ballynonty killing.
bio: Son of Humphrey Heffernan and Anastasia Ryan (parentage probable). Convicted with his brother James over the 1834 killing of Constable Feeney at Ballynonty; first sentenced to life, he was also transported. He married twice, had eleven children and died at Orange, NSW, on 10 Dec 1869 (NSW death cert. 5288/1869). Not to be confused with the tree's Patrick Heffernan (1763-1871).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (citing NSW death certificate 5288/1869)
